title: Loot Hunt
description: A team-based mini-game where players race to find a randomly selected item. The fastest team scores points and wins the match.
body:
**Loot Hunt**

Loot Hunt is a competitive team-based Minecraft mini-game where players race to find randomly selected items before the other teams do.

**How It Works**

Create teams, assign players, and start a match. Each round gives every team the same target item. Teams earn placement points based on how quickly they obtain the item, while the mod tracks round history and completion times.

**Features**

- Team-based item hunting gameplay
- Random survival-obtainable target items
- Optional custom target item for a match
- Configurable number of rounds
- Optional round time limits
- Configurable team teleport and spawn radius
- Pre-game countdown
- Live in-game HUD
- Operator menu for setup and match control
- Player team selection menu
- Score tracking with placement points
- Round history with team times
- Team colors and colored nametags
- Start particles and event sounds
- Victory title for the winning team
- Celebratory fireworks after the match

**Perfect For**

- Multiplayer challenges
- Server events
- Friendly competitions
- Survival race nights
- Fast replayable mini-game sessions
